About
Marco

Born and raised in the Netherlands, I'm a Creative Technologist based in Lisbon. I graduated from IADE European University and am now specialising in GIS and Science. I grew up with bilingual education in Dutch and English, and learned Portuguese at home.

My work sits at the intersection of creative computing and spatial technology. I am developing my GIS expertise through QGIS, ArcGIS and Python to analyse, visualise and communicate geographic data. From scripting spatial workflows in Python to building interactive web maps, I enjoy making data feel alive and meaningful.

Alongside that, I build immersive interactive experiences in Unreal Engine and Unity, design 3D assets in Blender, and work across the Adobe suite. Whether it's a VR escape room, a projection mapping animation or a spatial data visualization, I bring the same attention to detail to every project.

I'm accustomed to international environments and genuinely enjoy meeting new people and collaborating across disciplines.
